tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: :rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus zab mo gter gyi mdzod las: rig 'dzin tshe yi sgrub pa bzhugs: :

rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs lha la 'dud: rig 'dzin tshe yi sgrub pa ni: bsgrub gzhi mi shigs dwangs ma gsum: sgrub byed lha sngags dgongs pa gsal: sgrub pa'i rdzas dang bcas te bsgrub: grub 'bras rdo rje'i lus su 'gyur: sa ma ya: de la bkra shis gnas mchog tu: dkyil 'khor bag dro brjid ldan bsham: khyad par tshe yi 'brang rgyas dang: thabs shes rten 'brel rdzas bshams la: tshe yi mda' dar mtshan ldan 'dzug: phyi nang mchod pa du ma bkram: spos rol dang bcas byin chen dbab: de ni sgrub pa'i sta gon no: sa ma ya: dngos gzhi las kyi gzhung bsrangs la: bskyed rim gsal zhing bzlas brjod bya: khyad par dzap kyi dgongs pa ni: hrī: dkyil 'khor gtso mchog pad+ma thod phreng gi: thugs kar mi shigs dwangs ma 'od lnga'i klong: thabs dang shes rab pad+ma zla ba'i steng: zung 'jug 'od gsal snying po ye shes sems: bcom ldan tshe dpag med mgon sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag phyag rgya'i steng: 'chi med bcud kyis gang ba'i tshe bum bsnams: dar dang rin chen rgyan ldan skyil krung bzhugs: rang 'od bde ster lha mo tsan+dha lī: mda' dar bum 'dzin bde stong chen por sbyor: yab kyi thugs kar nyi zla'i ga 'u'i sbubs: ting 'dzin sems dpa' hrīḥyig bye ru'i mdog: mtha' skor mi phyed rdo rje'i sngags kyis mtshan: bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'od zer mkha' khyab 'phros: rang gi bla tshe chad nyams yar ba dang: 'byung bzhi'i snying po 'khor 'das dwangs bcud kun: 'chi med bdud rtsi 'od zer rnam par bsdus: phyag gi bum pa'i nang zhugs zhu zhing khol: lus kyi nang gang nad gdon sdig sgrib dang: dus min 'chi ba'i bag chags ma lus sbyangs: sgo gsum mi shigs dwangs ma gsum ldan dang: tshe dang ye shes rdo rje'i srog 'grub gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dza:

zhes pa'i sngags 'di rtse gcig bzla: 'bum phrag bzhi yis dngos grub thob: lha sku'i gsal snang brtan par bzung: 'byung 'jug rlung kun sngags su bsam: dbyings rig dbyer med ngang du bzhag: 'chi med ye shes 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: skabs su thugs dam rgyud bskul phyir: gdung ba'i shugs bskyed mda' dar g.yab: oṃ: 'chi med pad+ma drwa ba'i pho brang che: dwangs ma 'od lnga 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: rig 'dzin gtso bo rje btsun pad+ma 'byung: tshe bdag bcom ldan 'das dang gnyis su med: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro: sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes ji bzhin du: bde stong zung 'jug thig le'i klong nas bzhengs: sprul pa'i pho nya mgyogs ma las la skul: 'khor 'das snang srid nam mkha'i dwangs bcud khug: chos dbyings ye shes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: hūm̐: shar phyogs rin chen 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas: rdo rje hūm̐ chen kā ra sku bzhengs shig: 'khor 'das snang srid chu yi dwangs bcud khug: me long ye shes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru hūm̐ kā ra a yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: trāṃ: lho phyogs rin chen 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas: 'jam dpal khrag 'thung bshes gnyen sku bzhengs shig: 'khor 'das snang srid sa yi dwangs bcud khug: mnyam nyid ye shes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru mañdzu shrī mi tra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: hrī: nub phyogs rin chen 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas: dbang chen nā gārdzu na sku bzhengs shig: 'khor 'das snang srid me yi dwangs bcud khug: sor rtog ye shes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru nā gārdzu na ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐:

ā: byang phyogs rin chen 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas: phrin las pra bha hasti sku bzhengs shig: 'khor 'das snang srid rlung gi dwangs bcud khug: bya grub ye shes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru prahasti ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ḥ dza: shar lho rin chen 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas: mngon rdzogs dha na saṃskṛ sku bzhengs shig: 'khor 'das snang srid bde chen dwangs bcud khug: klong gyur ye shes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru dha na saṃskṛta ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nri dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ḥ hūm̐: lho nub rin chen 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas: 'chi med bi ma mi tra sku bzhengs shig: 'khor 'das snang srid bdud rtsi'i dwangs bcud khug: 'da' ka ye shes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru bi ma la mi tra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: baṃ: nub byang rin chen 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas: gsang bdag gu h+ya tsan+d+ra sku bzhengs shig: 'khor 'das snang srid stobs kyi dwangs bcud khug: dbyings grol ye shes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru gu h+ya tsan+d+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: ho: byang shar rin chen 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas: stobs ldan shīṃn+ta gar+bha sku bzhengs shig: 'khor 'das snang srid rtsal gyi dwangs bcud khug: mtha' grol ye shes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru shīn+taṃ gar+bha ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: hūm̐ hrī: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dbyings nas bzhengs: yi dam lha tshogs dngos grub gzi byin skyed: mkha' 'gro chos skyong phrin las glog ltar 'khyugs: rig 'dzin sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: bla tshe chad nyams yar ba rang sor tshud:

bar chad tshe 'phrang 'od gsal dbyings su zlog: srid zhi'i tshe bcud mi shigs thig ler stims: 'chi med 'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: tshe bh+rūm̐: g.yu bh+rūm̐: g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: ā yur+dz+nyā na g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: zhes bskul bdag dang sgrub rten la: tshe yi dwangs bcud yang yang bstim: mthar thug snying po hrīḥl 'dus: nyi zla 'od kyi drwa bas bcings: 'pho med brtan par rgyas gdab bya: a: spros pas 'khor 'das khyab pa'i tshe yi bcud: bsdus pas snying po mi shigs thig ler thim: bcings pas 'du 'bral med pa'i lu gu rgyud: mi 'gyur mi shigs rdo rje'i srog thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe bh+rūm̐ swā hā: sa ma ya: de ltar yang yang brtson pa yis: nyi zla shar dang bdud rtsi btung: rtsi shing 'bru sman rgyas pa sogs: rmi lam dge ba'i rtags byung na: tshe 'brang lhar gsal gsol ba gdab: 'chi med rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyis: bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs te: rdo rje tshe yi dbang mchog stsol: ces bskul tshe 'gugs bcud bsdus la: dngos grub bum pa spyi bor blang: oṃ: tshe yi 'brang rgyas nyi zla'i gwa 'u ru: mi 'gyur rtag pa ye shes lha tshogs bzhugs: 'chi med bder gshegs sku yi dbang bskur bas: stobs rtsal gzi brjid rgyas pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: tshe chang bdud rtsi mgrin par myang: ā: chos dbyings rang byung bhan+dha'i snod mchog tu: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud ye shes bdud rtsir 'khyil: 'gag med snying po gsung gi dbang bskur bas: rlung sngags mi shigs rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐:

wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: tshe ril snying gar blang zhing rol: hūm̐: brtan g.yo'i rang bzhin bde chen thig ler 'khyil: srid dang zhi ba'i tshe bcud 'du 'bral med: 'od gsal gnyug ma thugs kyi dbang bskur bas: skye 'chi med pa don gyi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rjes su rgyas gdab shis pa brjod: dga' ston tshogs 'khor rgya cher bya: des ni tshe yi bar chad zhi: tshe dang ye shes 'phel bar 'gyur: sa ma ya: snod ldan gdul bya rjes bzung na: khrus bya mtshams bcad srung 'khor bsgom: maṇ+ḍal dang bcas gsol ba gdab: rgyud sbyang dam ye gnyis med bstim: ting 'dzin gsal zhing tshe 'gugs bskul: dbang rnams bskur cing rgyas gdab bya: rjes kyi rim pa spyi ltar spyad: 'di ltar rnal 'byor sus bsgrubs na: dus min 'chi ba nges par bslu: tshe zad pa yang bsring bar nus: dwangs ma mi shigs gsum ldan gyi: rdo rje'i tshe la dbang 'byor 'gyur: sa ma ya: rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus gter gyi mdzod: rig 'dzin yongs rdzogs sgrub thabs las: mtha' rgyas tshe yi sgrub pa'i thabs: zab cing snying por 'dril ba 'di: ma 'ongs 'di spyod skyes bu yi: tshe yi bar chad zhi ba dang: 'gro 'dul phrin las rgyas pa'i phyir: lo tsā chen po nyid la gdams: rin chen sa yi gter du sbos: 'chi med dga' ston 'phel bar shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: gu h+ya: 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pas lha mdo 'bur mo bde chen pad+ma bkod nas dngos grub tu thob pa'o// //
